en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a large, ornate 19th‑century villa or institutional building behind bare winter trees and a low fence. The building has tall rectangular windows, pilasters, and a central entrance with an arched doorway and small staircase. In front is a landscaped garden or park area. At the top, printed in red, is a caption identifying the institute and its location in Nijmegen.
